_comment: The pytest suites share one rootdir and their test directories are not packages, so pytest imports every test module, and every helper module beside it, by its bare name: two files of one name stop collection (or one silently shadows the other). The test paths are read from [tool.pytest.ini_options] testpaths in this pyproject; skip_dirs are never searched; exempt_names may repeat (pytest re-imports a rootless conftest.py for each directory).
